title: An energy ceasefire nobody has confirmed, and an oil market that noticed
summary: Oil finished the week choppy and politics made it worse. President Trump announced an “energy ceasefire” between Russia and Ukraine effective immediately, days after a diesel-supply arrangement with Moscow that senators in both parties called potentially illegal; neither belligerent had confirmed the truce as Asian markets opened. Brent traded near $103.5 a barrel, well below its recent $109.97 peak but roughly 57% above a year ago, with the Strait of Hormuz still the structural risk. September US inflation data on 14 October is the next test for headline prices.
